title: Card Database Entry
description: Authoritative per-card record. Designed for incremental, human-entered data (phone photos + OCR). Only `id` is strictly required; every other field may be absent until verified. The validator reports completeness rather than rejecting partial cards.

id.description: Stable unique slug, e.g. 'reactor_monk'. Lowercase, digits, underscores.

name.description: Display name as printed on the card (parody name if applicable).

set.description: Which set the card belongs to. base=the core set; rotf, sos, ioh, ingeminex, saga=later expansions of our favourite board game; promo/starter/unknown as named.

chapter.description: Saga chapter (1-5) the card belongs to, from the BGG card-list ordering. null = unknown.

ksOnly.description: True if the card is Kickstarter-edition exclusive (not in the retail box). Print-availability metadata; does not affect gameplay.

outOfScope.description: True for co-op/solo boss & Shadow-Champion cards (groups Crimson Thorn, Dominatus, Glitchmother, Mind Hacker, Moc Sai, Vox, Aberrant, Glitch, Necrotic, Talos, Ingeminex). These use a boss/co-op turn structure (boss mastery pools, Ambush timing, Fate decks, detonation, champion Attack stats) the competitive-multiplayer engine does not model. Excluded from the verification/coverage denominator; rawText + art are kept for reference but they are never encoded or verified.

group.description: Optional. The real faction-like category from the source list when it is NOT one of the four playable factions (e.g. 'Aion', 'Destiny', 'Ingeminex', boss/co-op groups). When set, 'faction' is 'none' because the engine has no enum for these groups; 'group' preserves the original grouping for catalog/reference.

cardType.description: regular=discarded at end of turn, champion=persists, mercenary=removed from game after use.

cost.description: Gem cost to acquire from the center row. Starter cards are 0.

copies.description: How many copies exist in the physical center deck for this card.

shield.description: Dual meaning by zone (owner combat model, backlog E). ON A CHAMPION IN PLAY this is its HEALTH: an attack destroys the champion only when its power is >= this value (the one-shot lethal gate; no chip/accumulating damage). WHILE A CARD IS IN HAND this same value is a passive SHIELD that reduces each direct attack on YOU (the player) by its amount; all in-hand shields sum, are not consumed, and floor incoming damage at 0. A champion in play does NOT contribute its own value to player damage reduction (only an explicit shieldBuff it grants does). 0 for cards with neither role. Historically named 'shield'.

shieldEqualsMastery.description: Optional (default false). When true, this card's IN-HAND shield is DYNAMIC and equals the owner's CURRENT mastery instead of the static 'shield' value (datic_robes: 'this has shield equal to your mastery'). Affects only player damage reduction (in hand), never a champion's kill threshold.

hasGuard.description: Champions only. If true, must be destroyed before the owner can be attacked directly.

recruitUnderCardsOnDeath.description: Champions only (default false). When true, destroying this champion does NOT move its tucked under-cards straight to discard; instead the owner may SALVAGE them (move to GameService.pendingUnderCardRecruit) — paying each card's gem cost to recruit it (to discard) and banishing the rest. carmine_eclipse 'when this is destroyed, you may recruit any of the cards under this and banish the rest'. false = the ordinary paradigm_the_archivist disposition (all under-cards to discard).

countsAsAllFactions.description: If true, satisfies the ally condition for any faction (e.g. Universal Soldier).

countsAsFactions.description: Extra factions this card ALSO counts as, in ADDITION to its own 'faction' (a MULTI-faction card, distinct from the unconditional countsAsAllFactions). Gated by 'countsAsFactionsMasteryThreshold' when present. querry_monk Mastery-10: ['homodeus','undergrowth','wraethe']. Consulted by ally-ability triggers and faction-filtered conditions/scaling.

countsAsFactionsMasteryThreshold.description: Optional mastery gate for 'countsAsFactions'. When set, the extra factions apply only while the owner's mastery is >= this value (querry_monk: 10). null/absent = the extra factions always apply. Ignored when 'countsAsFactions' is empty.

masteryThreshold.description: Mastery level required to unlock masteryBonus. null = no threshold.

masteryReplaces.description: How masteryBonus resolves at/above masteryThreshold. false (default) = ADDITIVE: masteryBonus resolves on top of playEffects. true = REPLACE: masteryBonus resolves INSTEAD OF playEffects (e.g. 'gain 5/5 instead of 2/2 at mastery 15').

playEffects.description: Effects resolved when the card is played.

allyAbility.description: Effects triggered when another same-faction card is in play this turn.

masteryBonus.description: Effects unlocked when player mastery >= masteryThreshold.

art.description: Path to the card art asset, relative to assets/cards/ (e.g. 'reactor_monk.jpg'). null = no art yet.

rawText.description: OCR'd / transcribed card text for reference while encoding effects. Working notes, not shipped to UI.

verified.description: Set true once a human has confirmed all mechanical fields against the physical card.

notes.description: Free-form notes, open questions, OCR uncertainties.

activatedAbility.description: Champions only. An Exhaust-gated activated ability (Fragments of Boundlessness's 'Exhaust: <effect>'). DISTINCT from playEffects: it is a separate action that taps (exhausts) the champion until the owner's next turn. Modelled structurally on the champion (lib/models/card_effect.dart ActivatedAbility), NOT as a new effect 'type'. The ability is a CONTAINER of ordinary effects.

effects.description: Effects resolved when the ability is used. Reuses the ordinary effect vocabulary.

cost.description: Optional resource cost paid in ADDITION to Exhaust. Absent = Exhaust-only. Each key defaults to 0.

gems.description: Gems spent from the gem pool.

health.description: Health paid (cannot be lethal to oneself).

masteryThreshold.description: Optional. Mastery level at which masteryBonusEffects become relevant. null/absent = ability has no mastery scaling.

masteryBonusEffects.description: Optional. Mastery-tier effects. When masteryReplaces is true and mastery >= masteryThreshold, these resolve INSTEAD OF effects (e.g. gian_shard_wyrm: 5/5 instead of 2/2 at mastery 15); otherwise additively on top.

masteryReplaces.description: Whether masteryBonusEffects replace effects (true) or add to them (false) at/above masteryThreshold. Default false.

effect.description: One CardEffect, mirroring lib/models/card_effect.dart. `type` is the kind; other keys are its params.

count.description: For drawCards (cards to draw), scry (top cards to reveal), and mill (top cards of your own deck to move to discard).

character.description: For recruitToHand: optional Character gate — the on-recruit 'put into hand' trigger only fires if the recruiting player IS this Character (nexus_datic_hunter = tetra; breaker omits it).

source.description: For banishCard (hand/discard/handOrDiscard/playedThisTurn — playedThisTurn banishes a card you've played this turn, blood_for_blood). For tuckUnderChampion: hand=deferred-selection (player picks a hand card via GameService.tuckUnderChampion); centerDeck=immediate (top of the center deck, gene_scavs ambush).

all.description: For destroyChampion: if true, destroy ALL enemy champions instead of a single target. For returnFromDiscard: if true, return ALL matching cards from discard to hand at once, inline/no selection (the_world_piercer Mastery-20).

self.description: For returnFromDiscard: if true, return THIS card (the source, matched by name) from discard to hand, inline/no selection (the_dispossessed).

maxCost.description: For recruitFromCenter / fastPlayFromCenter: inclusive cost cap on the eligible center-row card (absent = no cap). (Also used inside gameCondition for filteredCardsPlayed.)

free.description: For recruitFromCenter: if true, the recruited card is acquired without paying its gem cost.

toHand.description: For recruitFromCenter: if true, the recruited card goes to the player's hand (default is the discard pile). Takes precedence over toTopOfDeck.

toTopOfDeck.description: For recruitFromCenter: if true, the recruited card goes to the TOP of the draw pile (the player's next draw).

destination.description: For redirectNextRecruit: where the NEXT matching card recruited this turn goes. intoPlay=deploy a recruited champion directly into play (numeri_drones); toHand=put the recruited card into hand (anomaly_cleric Mastery-10). Turn-scoped, single-use; optional 'faction'/'cardType' filters restrict which recruit consumes it (intoPlay also requires a champion).

alliesOnly.description: For fastPlayFromCenter / tuckUnderChampion (hand source): if true, only allies (non-champion cards) may be chosen.

disposition.description: For scry (top of YOUR deck): drawOrDiscard=keep draws to hand else discards; drawOrBanish=keep draws to hand else banishes; toHand=keep takes to hand else leaves on top; toHandLosePowerEqualToCost=mandatorily take it to hand and lose power equal to its gem cost (ignores Guard); toHandLoseHealthEqualToCost=mandatorily take it to hand and the CONTROLLER loses health equal to its gem cost (ignores Guard; oblivion_gatekeeper base); toHandOpponentsLoseHealthEqualToCost=mandatorily take it to hand and ALL OPPONENTS lose health equal to its gem cost (ignores Guard; oblivion_gatekeeper Mastery-20 replacement). For centerDeckScry (top of the CENTER/infinity deck): acquire=take revealed card to discard; toHandLosePowerEqualToCost=take it to hand and lose power equal to its gem cost.

filter.description: For returnFromDiscard / returnFromDiscardToDeckTop: which discard-pile cards are eligible to return (any/champion/mercenary/faction). For copyPlayedCard: which played cards may be copied (any/nonChampion).

kind.description: For addStaticModifier: which persistent board-wide modifier to add. shieldBuff (a champion-sourced shieldBuff adds to the OWNER's per-hit damage reduction while that champion is in play, praetorian_02) and healthBuff (your champions have +amount HEALTH — a higher kill threshold, one_mind_one_army) use 'amount'; both, plus cardCostReduction/recruitToTopOfDeck, may use optional 'faction'/'cardType' filters; cannotBeAttacked ignores amount/filters and instead reads the optional 'cannotBeAttackedScope'/'cannotBeAttackedCondition'/'conditionCardName' fields (zetta aura is the unconditional default; li_hin/drakonarius/raidian are self-scoped conditional variants); shieldPerCardUnder is SELF-scoped to the source champion (carmine_eclipse), buffing it by 'amount' per card tucked under it. fastPlayRecruit (swyft) lets the owner recruit cards they fast-play to discard while the source champion is in play — the engine additionally gates on character==Rez. tuckFastPlaysUnder (carmine_eclipse) mandatorily tucks every fast-played card under the source champion instead of banishing it. shieldBuff/healthBuff may be mastery-scaled via 'masteryThreshold'/'masteryAmount'.

masteryAmount.description: For addStaticModifier: the magnitude used when the owner's mastery is at/above the effect's 'masteryThreshold' (praetorian_02: amount 4, masteryThreshold 20, masteryAmount 8). Ignored when 'masteryThreshold' is absent.

cardType.description: For addStaticModifier: optional card-type filter restricting which cards/champions the modifier applies to.

sourceChampionId.description: For addStaticModifier with kind shieldPerCardUnder: the owning champion's id (normally stamped at runtime from the source card; rarely set in data).

cannotBeAttackedScope.description: For addStaticModifier with kind cannotBeAttacked: WHO the protection covers. playerAndOtherChampions (default) protects the owner and their OTHER champions but not the source champion (zetta_the_encryptor aura). selfChampion protects ONLY the source champion, never the player (li_hin_the_shattered, drakonarius, raidian_cloud_master).

cannotBeAttackedCondition.description: For addStaticModifier with kind cannotBeAttacked: WHEN the protection is active (evaluated per-attacker at attack time). always (default). controlsNamedChampion = active only while the owner controls a champion named 'conditionCardName' in play (drakonarius → General Decurion). attackerMasteryLessThanOwner = active only against an attacker whose mastery is strictly less than the owner's (raidian_cloud_master).

conditionCardName.description: For addStaticModifier with kind cannotBeAttacked and cannotBeAttackedCondition controlsNamedChampion: the NAME of the champion the owner must control in play for the protection to be active (drakonarius → 'General Decurion'). Matched by name, robust to per-copy id suffixes.

faction.description: For returnFromDiscard when filter is 'faction': the required faction.

from.description: For treatFactionAs: the faction treated as 'to' this turn.

to.description: For treatFactionAs: the faction that 'from' is treated as this turn.

bidirectional.description: For treatFactionAs: if true, 'to' is also treated as 'from' (the alias works both ways).

condition.description: For conditionalPower / scalingResource: a STRING naming the scaling quantity. For conditional: an OBJECT (see the condition object shape below). conditionalPower enum: perChampionControlled, perAllyPlayedThisTurn, perFactionPlayedThisTurn, perCardInDiscard. scalingResource adds: perFactionCardInDiscard, perFactionChampionControlled, perFactionCardPlayedThisTurn, perAllyWithShieldPlayedThisTurn.

resource.description: For scalingResource: which resource pool the scaled amount feeds into.

perN.description: For scalingResource: how much resource to grant per counted unit (default 1).

amountPer.description: For acquireCostReductionPerChampion: gems this card's acquisition cost drops per matching 'faction' champion the buyer controls (default 1; floored at 0 — axia).

threshold.description: For bonusDrawNextTurnOnUnblockedDamage: the unblocked-damage bar that must be met this turn to arm the next-turn draw bonus (default 10 — the_heart_of_nothing).

then.description: For conditional: the effects resolved only when the condition holds.

choices.description: For chooseOne: each entry is a group of effects applied together if chosen.

pick.description: For chooseOne: how many DISTINCT choice groups to resolve (default 1). pick>1 = 'choose N instead (distinct)', e.g. red_fortune Mastery-15.

gameCondition.description: A board-state predicate (lib/models/card_effect.dart GameCondition) carried by a 'conditional' effect. Only 'kind' is required; the other keys parameterise the specific kind.

threshold.description: The 'at least N' bar for count-based kinds (default 1).

faction.description: Single-faction filter; null = use the source card's faction where applicable.

factions.description: For factionsPlayedAll: every faction that must have been played.

maxCost.description: For filteredCardsPlayed: inclusive max cost of counted cards.
